description: The Statistics window (spec 11.K): Studio's Statistics page in a window of its own. A projector - it reads projections and never writes rules - so it needs the same core event verbs Stage does and nothing else; `guard::STATS_COMMANDS` is what it may ask the host for. Without a capability of its own it matched none, and a window that matches none gets no core permissions, so its `listen` was denied and the Live view never moved.
